en: The postcard features two black-and-white photographic views of a rural, wintry landscape. The upper image shows a church with a tall steeple on the left, some farm buildings, and a frozen or partially thawed body of water with rocks and a solitary person walking. The lower image presents a broader view of fields, scattered farmhouses, and barns. There is text at the bottom that reads 'Parti fra Nes, Hedemarken'.
